### The Gift of Marriage
Author: Jennifer Waddle
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-couples-devotional/crosswalk-couples-devotional-march-18.html
Passage: Genesis 5:1-2
Points:
- Marriage originated at the dawn of human history as a sacred gift directly created and blessed by God.
- In creating mankind in His likeness as male and female, God established union as a foundational blessing.
- Modern culture frequently devalues marriage into a superficial prize or a casual, consumerist commitment.
- Spouses whose relationship has grown shallow or distant can actively pursue a fresh start through Christ.
- Couples should set aside dedicated time to communicate honestly, address neglect, and ask the Lord to renew their bond.
